title: How To Start Wholesale Real Estate With $0 In 2026
summary: Step-by-step wholesaling pitch with no budget: free lists, free skip tracing, hundreds of daily cold calls, assign the contract to an investor; first fee expected after months of grind.

assertions.quote: You're not buying properties. You're putting them under contract and then finding somebody else to buy them.
Around 1,000 to 2,000 calls when you're brand new. The time investment, 3 to 4 hours a day, minimum.

verdicts.note: Practitioner accounts agree first deals take months of outreach; many never close one.

assertions.quote: the chances of you finding motivated sellers, is 10 times more likely than any other method

verdicts.note: Distress signals motivation, but no independent data compares lead-list conversion rates.

assertions.quote: All you have to do is click on those houses, see who the agent was that brought the buyer, and give them a call.
I promise you, you don't need to learn how to estimate repair costs.

verdicts.note: Comps help, but investors price on repair cost, so ignoring it leads to offers buyers reject.
